title: The Last Werewolf
description:
The Last Werewolf is a distinctive narrative experience that invites you to join Lachie on her quest to understand her newfound identity. Drop straight into an active case, In Media Res style, of one of her paranormal investigations. Piece together Lachie's story through dialogue, a lore book, a diary, and an online blog.

A Story About BalanceThe Last Werewolf uses supernatural elements to explore themes of identity and self-discovery. Through Lachie's journey of learning to live with her werewolf nature, the game presents a thoughtful metaphor for managing mental health, particularly Bipolar Disorder. The Wolf Meter mechanic reflects the daily balance of understanding your limits while still embracing life's experiences.

 

What to Expect• A Playable Short Story: A simple, intimate narrative experience designed to be experienced in a single sitting.

• Atmospheric World-Building: A cozy, relaxing focus on supernatural lore, community, and world-building, opting for an In Media Res in place of a complex plot.

• Light Choice & Cinematic Beats: Navigate dialogue and small cutscene moments smoothly without convoluted, stressful plot branching.

• Lachie's Personal Tools: Casually catch up on who she is at your own pace by reading through her diary, lore book, and blog
description_short: A story-driven interactive narrative follows Lachie, a young woman grappling with her newfound werewolf identity. Navigate her journey of self-discovery across three chapters as she searches for answers about who, and what, she is.
